Estimate the duration from now until this task completes, including waiting, travel and execution. Use only the supplied state. Show brief step-by-step working: compute the waiting time, the travel time and the execution time separately, then add them to get the total. End your response with the answer as a JSON object on its own final line: {"bid": nonnegative number}.
